limitations: synthetic tokenizer is NOT production-model-compatible (word/punct fixture)

latencyBaselineZeroDelayNote: 50 ms simulated per-request backend latency applied to every fake-server call (guard read-backs included)

queueCap.coverage: accepted ∪ pending == all entries, disjoint (merge-into-oldest, nothing dropped)

repeatSettleCallVolume.expectation: one call per unique source range; repeats cost zero calls

retrievalFixtures.QF-R3: superseded exclusion — guard-rejected (status step), zero superseded items
retrievalFixtures.QF-R4: keyword-only hybrid attribution disclosed as degraded, never counted as semantic
retrievalFixtures.QF-R5: empty result set → empty pack + visible note, no fabrication

retrievalFixtures.QF-C2: budget overflow splits into disjoint batches; union coverage complete
retrievalFixtures.QF-C3: queue cap merges overflow into the oldest batch; no entry lost
retrievalFixtures.QF-C4: repeated settles over the same coverage cost zero model calls
retrievalFixtures.QF-C5: failed extraction retains the SAME opId and full durable coverage
